assertions.assertion: Identifies Data Protection key ring as the root cause — each instance generates its own keys
assertions.rationale: It states each instance generates its own in-memory key ring so cookies from one node can't be decrypted by another.

assertions.assertion: Recommends configuring a shared key store (e.g., PersistKeysToDbContext, PersistKeysToAzureBlobStorage, or Redis)
assertions.rationale: It shows PersistKeysToDbContext, PersistKeysToAzureBlobStorage, and Redis options with a shared SetApplicationName.

assertions.assertion: Recommends server-side sessions with a shared store (AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions) instead of in-memory sessions
assertions.rationale: Fix 2 recommends AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions with SQL Server instead of in-memory sessions.

assertions.assertion: Shows code for AddDataProtection() with a persistent key store
assertions.rationale: Multiple AddDataProtection().PersistKeysTo...() code samples are provided.
